projects.name: Project 1
details: NATWEST
Bridges technical teams and business stakeholders to design, implement, payment systems, gateways,
and transactional processes. Key responsibilities include defining payment lifecycles—initiation,
authorization, settlement, and reconciliation
Roles and Responsibilities:
• Documented all business processes and operating procedures from scratch for an early-stage
startup.
• Continuously monitored and evaluated processes to find areas of improvement,
• Researched and presented to stakeholders, obtaining approvals for requirements and changes.
• Creating detailed workflow diagrams for payment initiation, authorization, and settlement
• Developing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirement
Specifications (FRS) for new payment products.
• Ensuring accuracy in transactions and managing chargebacks, and payment failures
• Facilitating sessions with product owners, developers, and other teams

projects.name: Project 2
details: Learning  Management  Application
Transforming higher education resources into accessible formats that align with today’s teaching and
learning needs, ensuring it serves learners from all backgrounds. Delivering the right content at a price
that meets institution’s requirements while respecting students’ expectations.
Roles and Responsibilities:
• Documented all business processes and operating procedures from the ground up for an early-stage
startup.
• Collaborated with Product Owners to maintain a healthy backlog.
• Led backlog prioritization to ensure alignment with business goals.
• Authored clear and actionable user stories.
• Gathered requirements from stakeholders and translated them into Epics.
• Conducted research and presented findings to stakeholders, securing approvals for requirements and
proposed changes.

projects.name: Project 3
details: Ticketing  Tool
The ticketing tool is developed to help the in-house IT Support team. The tool helps the team to track the
hardware/software issues within the organization and help the employees work much more efficiently by
resolving the reported issues as soon as possible.
Technology: Microsoft PowerApps, Power Automate, SharePoint Online
Roles and Responsibilities:
• Documented all business processes and operating procedures from scratch for an early stage
startup
• Continuously monitored and evaluated processes to find areas of improvement, significantly
improving the client experience by 32% by advising resource allocation to one -on-one health
monitoring
• Interchanged between IT and business contacts to manage project lifecycle, and ensured team
achieved 96% of deadlines by communicating realistic expectations.
• Researched and presented to stakeholders, obtaining approvals for requirements and changes.

projects.name: Project 4
details: Online Compliance  Portal
The Online Compliance Portal was developed to manage the compliance process of acts. The tool helps
the team to digitize the entire process of configuration of acts, sections, departments, groups etc., data
storage in a structured format, automated approvals, user interface to input compliance details along with
signature image upload and analytical reports.
Technology: Microsoft PowerApps, Power Automate, SharePoint Online
Roles and Responsibilities:
• Understanding source systems and customer requirements and prepared business
requirements and design documents.
• Understanding the team’s expectations.
• Generate emails which will automate the communication between approvers and submitters.
• Involved in creating roles for various users and restricting access to the data.

projects.name: Project 5
details: Invoice App – Leading  Journalism  company.
The project involved creating invoice app that can generate new invoices and manage invoices.
Technology: PowerApps, SharePoint Online, Power Automate, Power BI.
Roles and Responsibilities:
• Understanding source systems and customer requirements and build a canvas app from
scratch.
• Store the recorded safety observations.
• Designing a SharePoint data store that can store all the details without any errors/issues.
• Generating various invoices.
• Validating the user inputs so that the data is clean at the data store.

projects.name: Project 6
details: Training  App- Leading  Waste management  company
The application was developed to create training schedules for employees in the organization. The
schedules for several types of training such as personal safety can be created and conducted using the
app. There is provision for marking attendance also for each schedule. Emails are sent out to the
respective people for better coordination among those individuals. Role based access is also implemented
within the app, to make sure there is no unrestricted access.
Technology: PowerApps, Power Automate, Share Point Online
Roles and Responsibilities:
• Understanding source systems and customer requirements and was a part of the team
preparing business requirement and design documents.
• Understanding the current system and client expectations.
• Designing the UI of the application which had to be both simple as well as user friendly.
• Creating various forms which can be used by end user to enter visitor details.
• Validating the data entered by user to make sure that it is all clean.
Other Project  Details:
Worked with Multiple projects and Clients to reach their goal and preparation of SRS Documents, UAT
Testing, Defining the Tasks, helping the team to understand the requirement, Demonstration of the
progress to Client.
Technology: PowerApps, Power Automate, Share Point Online, PHP, SQL, SQL Server, Power BI,
Tableau,
Dot net, Signal R.
Roles and Responsibilities:
• Plan and implement projects
• Help define project scope, goals, and deliverables
• Define tasks and required resources
• Collect and manage project team
• Create schedule and project timeline
• Track deliverables
• Support and direct team
• Lead quality assurance
• Implement and manage change when necessary to meet project outputs
IT S K I L S E T
Operating Systems: Windows Platforms
Technologies: Tableau Desktop, Tableau Server, Amazon Quick Site, Jira,
Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Zoho for defect
tracking.
Database: MySQL, SQL server
Tools: Android Studio, Momentics, Jira, confluence, Zoho Project management, Microsoft
